# Role and permission matrix

Permissions are enforced on the server for every request. The browser only uses them to hide controls.
On top of the role grants below, every case-linked record is also filtered by:

- **Company/branch scope** — the user's assigned companies and branches (unscoped roles see assigned cases only).
- **Assignment** — Investigator, Legal Officer, HR Officer, Restricted External Advocate see only cases they are assigned to.
- **Confidentiality clearance** — a user sees a record only if their clearance (capped by role) covers its level.
- **Sensitive modules** — Bank and M-Pesa analysis (except System Administrator, Compliance Reviewer, Internal Audit Reviewer); Disciplinary action (except System Administrator, Management Approver, Compliance Reviewer) additionally require the user to be assigned to the case.
- **Restricted cases** — need-to-know: only assigned users (and the System Administrator) can open them.
- **Maker-checker** — nobody can approve, verify or decide their own request.

## Clearance cap per role

| Role                         | Highest clearance   |
| ---------------------------- | ------------------- |
| System Administrator         | Restricted          |
| Lead Investigator            | Restricted          |
| Investigator                 | Highly confidential |
| Internal Audit Reviewer      | Highly confidential |
| Compliance Reviewer          | Restricted          |
| Legal Officer                | Restricted          |
| HR Officer                   | Highly confidential |
| Finance Reviewer             | Confidential        |
| Management Approver          | Highly confidential |
| Read-Only Executive          | Confidential        |
| Restricted External Advocate | Confidential        |
